verses.html: 1 As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples
verses.text: 1 As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples

verses.html: 2 and said to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
verses.text: 2 and said to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.

verses.html: 3 If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”
verses.text: 3 If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”

verses.html: 4 So they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,
verses.text: 4 So they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,

verses.html: 5 and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
verses.text: 5 and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”

verses.html: 6 The disciples answered as Jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.
verses.text: 6 The disciples answered as Jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.

verses.html: 7 Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.
verses.text: 7 Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.

verses.html: 8 Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
verses.text: 8 Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.

verses.html: 9 The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
verses.text: 9 The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”

verses.html: 10 “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
verses.text: 10 “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”

verses.html: 11 Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
verses.text: 11 Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

verses.html: 1 And when they come near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, to the Mount of Olives, he sends out two of his disciples
verses.text: 1 And when they come near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, to the Mount of Olives, he sends out two of his disciples

verses.html: 2 and says to them, “Go into the village opposite you, and immediately, entering into it, you will find a colt tied up, on which no one of men has yet sat. Untie it and bring it {here}.
verses.text: 2 and says to them, “Go into the village opposite you, and immediately, entering into it, you will find a colt tied up, on which no one of men has yet sat. Untie it and bring it {here}.

verses.html: 3 And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it and immediately he sends it back here.’”
verses.text: 3 And if anyone says to you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord has need of it and immediately he sends it back here.’”

verses.html: 4 And they went away and found a colt having been tied up at a door outside on the street, and they untie it.
verses.text: 4 And they went away and found a colt having been tied up at a door outside on the street, and they untie it.

verses.html: 5 And some of the ones standing there were saying to them, “What are you doing, untying the colt?”
verses.text: 5 And some of the ones standing there were saying to them, “What are you doing, untying the colt?”

verses.html: 6 And they spoke to them just as Jesus told them, and they let them go.
verses.text: 6 And they spoke to them just as Jesus told them, and they let them go.

verses.html: 7 And they brought the colt to Jesus and throw their cloaks upon it, and he sat on it.
verses.text: 7 And they brought the colt to Jesus and throw their cloaks upon it, and he sat on it.

verses.html: 8 And many spread their cloaks on the road, and others, branches, having cut {them} from the fields.
verses.text: 8 And many spread their cloaks on the road, and others, branches, having cut {them} from the fields.

verses.html: 9 Both the ones going before and the ones following were crying out, “Hosanna! Blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord.
verses.text: 9 Both the ones going before and the ones following were crying out, “Hosanna! Blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord.

verses.html: 10 Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!”
verses.text: 10 Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna in the highest!”

verses.html: 11 And he entered into Jerusalem, into the temple; and having looked around at everything, the hour already being late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
verses.text: 11 And he entered into Jerusalem, into the temple; and having looked around at everything, the hour already being late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

verses.html: 1 After that, Jesus and his apprentices continued to walk toward the city of Jerusalem, and they were getting closer. They were near the Mount of Olives, just outside the villages of Bethphage and Bethany. Jesus told two of his apprentices to go {ahead of them}.
verses.text: 1 After that, Jesus and his apprentices continued to walk toward the city of Jerusalem, and they were getting closer. They were near the Mount of Olives, just outside the villages of Bethphage and Bethany. Jesus told two of his apprentices to go {ahead of them}.

verses.html: 2 He instructed them, “Enter the village {of Bethphage}, which you see ahead of you. As soon as you enter it, you will see a young donkey that someone has tethered. It is an animal that no one has ever ridden. Remove the tether {from the young donkey} and lead it to me here.
verses.text: 2 He instructed them, “Enter the village {of Bethphage}, which you see ahead of you. As soon as you enter it, you will see a young donkey that someone has tethered. It is an animal that no one has ever ridden. Remove the tether {from the young donkey} and lead it to me here.

verses.html: 3 People might ask you, ‘What are you doing?’ In that case, tell them, ‘The Lord needs this young donkey. As soon as {he finishes using it}, he will return it here.’”
verses.text: 3 People might ask you, ‘What are you doing?’ In that case, tell them, ‘The Lord needs this young donkey. As soon as {he finishes using it}, he will return it here.’”

verses.html: 4 So the two apprentices left {for the village}. They saw the young donkey standing on the road. Someone had tethered it to the door of a house. They started to remove its tether.
verses.text: 4 So the two apprentices left {for the village}. They saw the young donkey standing on the road. Someone had tethered it to the door of a house. They started to remove its tether.

verses.html: 5 Some people who were there asked the two apprentices, “Why are you removing the tether from the young donkey?”
verses.text: 5 Some people who were there asked the two apprentices, “Why are you removing the tether from the young donkey?”

verses.html: 6 The two apprentices told those people what Jesus had instructed them to say. Then, those people allowed the two apprentices {to take the young donkey}.
verses.text: 6 The two apprentices told those people what Jesus had instructed them to say. Then, those people allowed the two apprentices {to take the young donkey}.

verses.html: 7 They led the young donkey to Jesus. Then they spread their coats on the young donkey, and Jesus rode on it.
verses.text: 7 They led the young donkey to Jesus. Then they spread their coats on the young donkey, and Jesus rode on it.

verses.html: 8 Then, {to honor Jesus,} many people laid their coats down on the path {in front of Jesus}. Other people cut down leafy plants that were growing in nearby farms {and laid them down on the path too}.
verses.text: 8 Then, {to honor Jesus,} many people laid their coats down on the path {in front of Jesus}. Other people cut down leafy plants that were growing in nearby farms {and laid them down on the path too}.

verses.html: 9 People walked in front of Jesus and behind him. They were shouting, “Praise God! May God bless him who is here to represent the Lord!
verses.text: 9 People walked in front of Jesus and behind him. They were shouting, “Praise God! May God bless him who is here to represent the Lord!

verses.html: 10 The kingdom that our ancestor King David ruled is now here again! May God bless it! May everything in heaven praise God!”
verses.text: 10 The kingdom that our ancestor King David ruled is now here again! May God bless it! May everything in heaven praise God!”

verses.html: 11 Then Jesus went into the city of Jerusalem and he visited the temple area. He examined everything that was there. After that, because it was evening, he and his 12 representatives returned to the village of Bethany.
verses.text: 11 Then Jesus went into the city of Jerusalem and he visited the temple area. He examined everything that was there. After that, because it was evening, he and his 12 representatives returned to the village of Bethany.
